WHAT WE DO / WORKPLACE PLANNING

A clear brief.
A stronger starting point.

Understand how your team works before deciding how your office should look.

Let’s talk about your space ↗
THE CONVERSATION

Start with what
your space needs.

Scope, deliverables and availability are discussed for each brief.

01

Discover the working day

Map headcount, attendance, focused tasks, collaborative work, visitor journeys and the practical needs of different teams.

02

Test the layout

Explore workstation positions, meeting settings, storage and circulation together. Check what fits without reducing every decision to desk count.

03

Make the brief useful

Agree the priorities, constraints and questions still to resolve. A useful brief makes later design and budget decisions easier to assess.

COME PREPARED

A useful first conversation.

✓ A floor plan or approximate area

✓ Team size and working patterns

✓ Your priorities and non-negotiables

✓ A budget range and desired move date
